purpose: Support Chapter 9 without inventing a single scalar adequacy order. Each row records one source-owned monotone shortcut that fails under its own scientific type.
claim_ceiling: This matrix is not a theorem that every notion of richer information lowers adequacy.
Rows use different carriers, estimands, contracts, and comparison orders and therefore may not be pooled into one scalar effect or one global partial order.
The safe synthesis claim is that no one listed richness proxy is privileged as an automatic certificate of adequacy across the dissertation's distinct scientific responsibilities.
TU-1 remains the exact theorem for revision after compression; the rows below are source-owned counterexamples supporting the broader dissertation synthesis.

rows.richness_proxy: more biologically proximal or more numerous observed channels
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: richer observation => closer identification of the latent mechanism
rows.decisive_result: With k multiplicative channels and r independent direct anchors, the residual unidentified dimension is k-1-r; adding observations that do not independently anchor the remaining gauge directions does not identify the latent channel decomposition.
rows.safe_conclusion: Identification strength depends on which independent directions are anchored, not on observational richness alone.

rows.richness_proxy: more reproducible or universal-looking lead-before-loss ordering among event trajectories
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: more consistent precedence => stronger predictive warning validity
rows.decisive_result: All six frozen thresholds led 35/35 and 33/33 observed losses but also fired in 48/48 and 49/49 non-events, yielding specificity 0 and binary-marker AUC 0.5.
rows.safe_conclusion: Temporal precedence is not a monotone proxy for discrimination.

rows.richness_proxy: more available measurable variables or arbitrary extra measurements
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: more measurable variables => more useful mechanism resolution; measurement order is neutral
rows.decisive_result: Information-guided sequential design reaches the same resolved-confounding endpoint with fewer observations and far fewer nuisance selections than random ordering, while some available candidates have zero current mechanism information value.
rows.safe_conclusion: Measurement value is conditional on the current admissible mechanism set and must be recomputed after each outcome.

rows.richness_proxy: one increasingly detailed eco-genetic summary used as a universal state descriptor
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: a richer common summary => adequate representation of every target-relevant state
rows.decisive_result: Potential viability, realised occupancy, demographic/genetic quantities and realised function follow different fragmentation responses; states sharing common marginals can also differ in cross-layer alignment and exact next interaction transition.
rows.safe_conclusion: State adequacy is target-relative; adding detail to one summary does not turn it into a universal state.

rows.richness_proxy: physical/local interface width as a proxy for required causal memory
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: narrower physical boundary => smaller exact future-response memory
rows.decisive_result: A relay with a focal/exterior cut of at most one and uniformly bounded local alphabets can require 2^m open-grammar response distinctions, equivalently m exterior response bits.
rows.safe_conclusion: Static physical cut size is not an exact bound on counterfactual response memory under an open future grammar.

rows.richness_proxy: size of the newly admitted intervention repertoire or viable-carrier gain
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: smaller capability gain => smaller representation and monitoring burden
rows.decisive_result: For every m>=1, one new controllable action can add exactly one viable world while refining a retained present slice from one state to 2^m states and creating exactly m bits of monitoring debt under unchanged evidence.
rows.safe_conclusion: Capability change and knowledge burden need not scale together.

rows.richness_proxy: confidence in or exactness of an accepted source macro-law
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: a law that is exact at the source => the same law remains exact after structural replacement
rows.counterexample_type: source-relative transport theorem and history-completion boundary
rows.decisive_result: Transport requires explicit source-target operational coherence; route disagreement in complete carried terminal maps forces explicit history modes, one per distinct map.
rows.safe_conclusion: Source exactness is not a monotone certificate of portability after replacement.

rows.richness_proxy: more repeated observations under the same failure architecture
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: more repeats => evidence strength equivalent to diversified observation modes
rows.counterexample_type: failure-domain guarantee theorem and equal-effort witness
rows.decisive_result: Within one shared failure domain, arbitrarily many repeats cannot raise the worst-case guarantee beyond the declared failure-domain ceiling, while independent modes can provide a stronger guarantee at equal raw effort.
rows.safe_conclusion: Evidence strength depends on failure diversity and the observation contract, not raw replicate count alone.

synthesis_rule.permitted: Across these typed responsibilities, none of the recorded richness proxies is an automatic certificate of scientific adequacy.
synthesis_rule.forbidden: Do not infer a universal scalar law that more detail, more measurement, more memory, more intervention, or more repetition always increases or decreases adequacy.
synthesis_rule.exact_substrate: TU-1 separately proves the factorization criterion and exact revision debt for same-carrier revision after compression.
